geometry_notes: All dimensions are printed on the sheets and were read visually from 400 dpi renders. Every vertical chain closes to the printed depth, and every width chain closes to the printed flange widths.
Straight splays with no drawn chamfers or fillets. The sheets carry no chamfer note.
The midspan I section is used. The thickened end sections (Section 1-1 / 25-25) are rectangular 600/750 wide end blocks and are excluded.
This is one project design, not an NHA national standard. It does not match NHA Types A-H; for example, NHA Type E is 2000 deep with 700/180/600 widths.
The structural notes on PDF p72 cite AASHTO LRFD 2010 and the West Pakistan Code of Practice for Highway Bridges 1967. No US AASHTO beam type is named, and no US geometry is transferred.
No section properties are printed. Checks are analytic only.
